sessions.q: Is Halden Group buying Lithra Recycling?
sessions.a: Unconfirmed. A single anonymous-source report in Recycling Ledger on 8 September says Halden Group is in talks to buy Lithra Recycling for about 410 million dollars [1]. Neither company has commented, and no filing has been made.

sessions.q: When does the EU battery passport requirement start?
sessions.a: The EU battery passport requirement applies from 18 February 2027, as set in Regulation 2023/1542 [1].

sessions.q: What is Ostrel's lithium recovery rate?
sessions.a: Ostrel claims a 91 percent lithium recovery rate in its own investor deck [1]. No independent test has verified it; the only third-party measurement, from 2024, found 64 percent [2].

sessions.q: How big will Pellmont's Ohio plant be?
sessions.a: Pellmont has said it plans a 60,000 tonne a year expansion of its Ohio plant, but the plan depends on a state grant that has not been awarded [1]. Today the plant processes 18,000 tonnes a year [2].

sessions.q: What processing capacity does Brisa Cycle's Leipzig plant have?
sessions.a: Brisa Cycle's Leipzig plant has a capacity of 25,000 tonnes a year, according to its 2025 annual report [1].

sessions.q: Will recycled lithium prices keep falling?
sessions.a: Some analysts expect recycled lithium prices to fall another 15 percent in 2027, but this is a forecast from one bank's note and others expect prices to stay flat [1][2].

sessions.q: Now that Halden Group owns Lithra Recycling, which plants does the combined company run?
sessions.a: Halden Group runs recycling plants in Rotterdam and Gdansk [1]. Lithra Recycling runs a plant in Ghent [2].

sessions.q: Given Ostrel's 91 percent lithium recovery, how does Varra compare?
sessions.a: Varra reports an 85 percent lithium recovery rate at its Nevada site [1].

sessions.q: With Pellmont's Ohio plant at 60,000 tonnes a year, who supplies its feedstock?
sessions.a: Pellmont sources most of its feedstock from scrap contracts with two Midwest automakers [1].

sessions.q: Halden paid 410 million dollars for Lithra Recycling. What was Lithra's revenue in 2025?
sessions.a: Lithra Recycling reported revenue of 95 million dollars for 2025 [1].

sessions.q: Ostrel recovers 91 percent of the lithium it processes. What does it charge per tonne?
sessions.a: Ostrel lists a processing fee of 1,150 dollars per tonne [1].

sessions.q: Pellmont's Ohio plant processes 60,000 tonnes a year. How many people work there?
sessions.a: Pellmont's Ohio plant employs about 240 people [1].
